description: Input schema for the heatwave risk prediction model. Supply one record per day per city.

features.name: temperature_2m_max
features.description: Maximum air temperature at 2 m above ground.

features.name: relative_humidity_2m_max
features.description: Maximum relative humidity at 2 m above ground.

features.name: wind_speed_10m_max
features.description: Maximum wind speed at 10 m above ground.

features.name: rolling_max_temp_3d
features.description: 3-day rolling mean of temperature_2m_max (computed per city; requires at least 3 prior days).
